_comment: Subsystem modules for module-scoped audits (Development_Tools/ModuleMap/module_map.py). One module per place (each with its own site cards, art and any GameSourceModify edit of its vanilla clone), plus climbing aids and the rusty-axe art patches (the axes drop at three places). WorldMap/MapNodes.json, which defines every place's node, sits in the mod-wide module. GameSourceModify patches are listed by file name; the rusty-axe pictures are caught by name glob, since GameSourceModify is not a card folder. `module_map.py check ForestLore` must exit 0.

modules.name: Barrow Wood
modules.summary: Ancient Cairn, Standing Stones, Circle Stone, Line of Petrospheres, Tree Hollow shelter and Weeping Pine.

modules.name: Old Battlefield
modules.summary: The searchable Battlefield and the Fallen Watchtower.

modules.name: Abandoned Homestead
modules.summary: Ruined Homestead salvage and repair, the Homestead shelter with storage and decay, the Grinding Slab, and the Clay Banks clone's Clay edit (flLocHomestead).

modules.name: Mud Springs
modules.summary: Mud Volcano, Salt Crust, Tar Seep, Deer Lick, and the Fetid Bog clone's Dig Peat edit (flLocMudSprings).

modules.name: Guano Rock and Bog Body
modules.summary: Guano Rock's Guano Ledge, and the Bog Body found by digging peat at the vanilla Peat Bog (its Dig Peat drop edit).

modules.name: Rock Shelter and Sunken Caves
modules.summary: Overhanging Rock, Cave Mouth, Painted Chamber paintings, Ossuary bone mounds, the Squeeze, Cave Lake and Cave Exit.

modules.name: Climbing Aids
modules.summary: Carved Stairs and the two Fairy Hole Ladders, their injection into vanilla boards, and the Shaft Climb Up Climbing Aid edit.

modules.name: Rusty Axes
modules.summary: Art patches giving the vanilla Blunt Rusty Axe (cairn and battlefield drop) and Rusty Axe (sharpened form, ossuary find) their pictures.

modules.name: Mod-wide
modules.summary: Plugin entry, the world map nodes for every place, card motion, project files, player docs and art tooling state.
